supersession_note: v1 and v2 are NOT modified; they remain audit records for results already published under them. v3 makes the magnitude/VRP regime ADVISORY instead of a hard veto, keeps the eruption block, relaxes the calm requirement, adds a $1000 per-trade max-risk cap, and uses live Robinhood spot as the price anchor when available. Deliberately trades more; defined risk + the cap + shadow tracking manage it. This is a NEW hypothesis family, not a softening of frozen v2.
objective: Promote the researched v11 rule into the LIVE advisory lane. Until now the live desk ran the v3-equivalent rule (eruption veto + Qlib lean routing + POP + IV/RV + $1,000 cap) and had NEITHER the 200-day trend gate (v5) NOR the call momentum gate (v10) NOR any managed exit (v11). This closes the gap between what was researched and what is actually alerted.

evidence_from_options_etf_gate_v1.finding: Under a purely global entry rule every universe symbol entered on identical dates: pooled n=369 collapsed to 41 cluster-adjusted observations, and cluster_adjusted n equalled spy_only n.
evidence_from_options_etf_gate_v1.implication: Widening the universe increases live candidate COVERAGE but adds close to zero independent statistical evidence unless a per-asset filter (Qlib lean/conviction) actually discriminates between symbols. Do not expect a wider universe to help the gate.
evidence_from_options_etf_gate_v1.gate_status: PBO 0.0159 (passes) but Deflated Sharpe -6.32 (fails). Not cleared.

scope.width_policy: The nine v1 symbols keep their v1 widths exactly so results stay comparable with options_etf_gate_v1. New symbols use a frozen price band: <$40 -> 1.0, $40-100 -> 2.0, >$100 -> 5.0, evaluated once at registration and frozen thereafter.
scope.data_note: XLC has a shorter history (listed 2018); all other symbols carry the full local window.
scope.excluded: single stocks, leveraged/inverse ETFs, FX, crypto, indexes, futures, and every symbol outside this frozen map

entry_policy.request_freshness: The finalizer accepts only a request generated on the same America/New_York calendar date.

structure_routing.rule: Qlib per-asset directional lean selects the structure; a symbol is evaluated for exactly one structure per day.
structure_routing.no_structure_shopping: If the routed structure fails validation the symbol is rejected. The finalizer must never retry a different structure to manufacture a candidate.

qlib.status: SHADOW discovery input; lack of promotion is displayed and never hidden
qlib.neutral_policy: A neutral lean carries no directional conviction, so the iron condor does NOT use the conviction threshold. It instead requires a richer volatility premium (see asset_volatility) so the looser directional bar cannot become a back door.

asset_volatility.realized_vol: annualized standard deviation of the last 20 completed daily log returns from the local Qlib CSV

contracts.long_leg: same expiry, exactly spread_width beyond the short strike
contracts.entry_price: natural executable-side credit: short bid minus long ask, summed over sides

hard_veto.note: The ONLY hard blocks are a predicted vol eruption (genuine 'do not sell premium into a coming blowup' protection) and missing/stale signal or Qlib data. Magnitude and calm no longer block; they advise. The eruption block is never relaxed to find trades.

advisory_sizing.policy: magnitude_pct is shown and drives a size_hint only: at/above magnitude_pct_high the candidate is flagged 'reduce size' (1 lot / smaller); below, 'normal'. It never removes a candidate. calm_5d/calm_21d are displayed as context, not gates.
advisory_sizing.vrp: VRP percentile is advisory context (rich VRP favors selling premium); never a standalone block.

signal_source.spot: live Robinhood equity quote when a same-session live-market snapshot is supplied; else prior qlib close
signal_source.realized_vol: always the trailing-20 historical RV from the local Qlib CSV (no meaningful intraday RV)
signal_source.note: Python stays authoritative; Codex only supplies read-only live quotes. spot_source is recorded per row.

entry_policy.pop_note: Probability of profit at expiry (tastytrade-style, risk-neutral BS prob beyond the structure breakeven[s]); candidates below 0.51 are dropped. Advisory filter added with the v3 live policy; only removes trades, never adds.

trend_gate.rule: do NOT sell PUT-side premium (put spread / iron condor) when close < 200-day SMA

call_momentum_gate.rule: do NOT sell CALL premium when 126-session momentum > +0.10

structure_invariants.etf_short_put_spread_v1: credit > 0 and credit < put width; max risk = width - credit
structure_invariants.etf_short_call_spread_v1: credit > 0 and credit < call width; max risk = width - credit
structure_invariants.etf_iron_condor_v1: one expiry, both sides present, total credit > 0 and total credit < max(put width, call width); only one side can finish in the money, so max risk = max(width) - total credit

portfolio_policy.max_trade_risk_note: Hard rail: any candidate whose defined max risk exceeds $1000 is dropped. Defined-risk ETF spreads (~$100-500) pass; this only excludes oversized structures.

trial_accounting.note: no new search; this adopts already-registered gates into production.

macro_policy.hq_macro_universe: context and audit metadata only; never a source of tradable symbols
macro_policy.macro_gpu: context only unless fresh; stale or missing stays unknown and cannot create a candidate

operating_status: SHADOW advisory; accepted by the user as the operating ETF lane; not gate-cleared.
gap_discovered: Audit on 2026-07-24 found no trend/momentum logic in desk/etf_options.py. The v4-v14 gates existed only in desk/etf_backtest.py. The live lane's shadow ledger also measured hold-to-expiry, while the research assumed a 50% profit target. The live desk was therefore NOT the strategy the backtests described.

changes_to_live.1_trend_gate_v5: Do not sell PUT-side premium (put spread / iron condor) when the symbol's close is below its 200-day SMA. Backtest evidence: cut the 2022 loss from -$7,025 to -$2,802.
changes_to_live.2_momentum_gate_v10: Do not sell CALL-side premium when the symbol's 126-session momentum exceeds +10%. Backtest evidence: call PnL -$913 -> -$454; cluster total +22%.
changes_to_live.3_exit_management_v11: ADVISORY exit signals on the daily marks: flag CLOSE_TARGET when a position can be bought back for <= 50% of entry credit, and CLOSE_STOP when the cost to close reaches 3x entry credit (a realized loss of 2x credit). Backtest evidence: 2022 -$2,880 -> -$2,312 at equal total PnL.
changes_to_live.not_changed: Universe (frozen 31), structures, POP>=0.51, IV/RV floors, $1,000 per-trade cap, eruption veto, DTE window, delta targets, read-only Robinhood, 127.0.0.1 UI, human places every order.

honest_status_of_the_evidence.gate: v11 FAILS the canonical overfit gate (cluster-adjusted DSR -36.8, PBO 0.0). It is NOT gate-cleared and this promotion does not claim it is.
honest_status_of_the_evidence.pricing: All supporting backtests use Black-Scholes modeled prices with proxied IV, not real option fills -> an UPPER BOUND. Real-option confirmation is blocked on OPRA/Polygon.
honest_status_of_the_evidence.in_sample: The gates were selected on this same 2019-2026 sample. Expect live results to be worse than backtested.
honest_status_of_the_evidence.why_promote_anyway: This is an ADVISORY desk: it sends Telegram alerts and a human decides every trade. The change makes the alerts match the best-researched rule instead of an older, strictly-worse one (v3 lost -$7,025 in 2022 where v11 lost -$2,312 on the same data). Promoting a better-researched advisory rule is a lower bar than promoting a strategy to automated execution, which is NOT happening.

monitoring: The SHADOW ledger keeps tracking every alerted candidate hold-to-expiry as the canonical measurement, so live results accumulate against the same yardstick. If live tracking diverges materially from backtest expectations, revert to v3 behavior and re-open the research.
promotion_scope: ADVISORY ONLY. No live execution, no broker keys, no automated orders. Robinhood remains read-only.

exit_policy.profit_target: CLOSE_TARGET when buy-back <= 50% of entry credit
exit_policy.stop_loss: CLOSE_STOP when buy-back >= 3x entry credit (loss = 2x credit)
exit_policy.measurement_note: hold-to-expiry remains the canonical SHADOW measurement so the ledger stays comparable
